title: Paint your own Doormat
seo_title: Paint Your Own Christmas Doormat Workshop in Bolivar, MO
description: This workshop at The Creative Root lets you choose your colors and paint a festive Christmas doormat for your door, and all supplies are provided. You can come solo, bring a friend, or make it a creative date; two people can share one mat for $25 total, and each additional doormat is $25. It takes place Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 1:30 PM at 115 N Main Ave in Bolivar, MO. Space is limited, so reserve in advance and tell the organizer whether one or two people will attend.
address: 115 N Main Ave, Bolivar, MO 65613-1517, United States, Bolivar, MO
